name: Library Volunteer Program (Williamson County Public Library)
what_you_do: Help library staff with support tasks. Volunteers do not replace library staff work.
who_can_apply: Anyone 14 or older. If you are a minor, a parent or guardian must sign a form that confirms your age and a release.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are kept on file for six months if no job fits right now.
how_to_apply: Send an application. Have a character reference and an emergency contact ready. Call 615-786-0142. You can also email deborah.reschke@williamsoncounty-tn.gov.
notes: Jobs depend on what the library needs at the time. Not every applicant gets a spot.
